description: This file provides network utility functions for resolving TCP addresses and URLs, comparing URLs, and handling network errors within the etcd project. It includes functions for DNS resolution, URL parsing, and equality checks, with a focus on resolving hostnames to IP addresses and comparing URL equivalence.

methods.name: resolveTCPAddrDefault
methods.description: Resolves a TCP address from a string, using a context for cancellation.

methods.name: resolveTCPAddrs
methods.description: Resolves a list of URL slices to their TCP addresses, replacing hostnames with IP addresses.

methods.name: resolveURL
methods.description: Resolves the hostname in a URL to its TCP address, with special handling for Unix schemes.

methods.name: urlsEqual
methods.description: Checks if two URL slices are equivalent, resolving hostnames if necessary.

methods.name: URLStringsEqual
methods.description: Checks if two string slices of URLs resolve to the same IP addresses.

methods.name: urlsToStrings
methods.description: Converts a slice of URLs to their string representations.

methods.name: stringsToURLs
methods.description: Parses a slice of strings into URL objects.

methods.name: IsNetworkTimeoutError
methods.description: Determines if an error is a network timeout error.
